backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a skill gap analyzer with resume management, job role matching, access control, and blob storage; includes types for resumes, skills, education, work experience, and comparison metrics with functions for scoring and analysis.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: AddJobRolePage creation, AdminPanel navigation link, and App.tsx routing configuration for the new job role creation route.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components and pages including routing, authentication, admin features, resume upload/analysis workflows, and visualization components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes including colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and root div mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, analysis, dashboard, admin panel, add job role, resume upload/results, and comprehensive results; includes authentication state management and profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Access denied screen component displaying a shield alert icon and message for unauthorized users attempting to access admin-restricted pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Higher-order component that checks admin permissions via useIsCallerAdmin hook and renders children only for authorized admins or shows AccessDeniedScreen.
frontend/src/components/CompareResumesVi: Resume comparison view component that displays side-by-side analysis of multiple resumes with metrics including overall score, experience level, education count, skills, and certifications.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDeleteDia: Reusable alert dialog component for confirming resume deletion with cancel/confirm actions and loading state support.
frontend/src/components/DownloadReportBu: Button component that generates and downloads a personalized PDF analysis report using the pdfGenerator service, showing loading state during generation.
frontend/src/components/GapAnalysisResul: Displays skill gap analysis results in two cards showing matching skills (with green styling) and missing/insufficient proficiency skills (with red/orange styling), categorized by technical and soft skills with proficiency level badges.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing job roles with title, description, and dynamic skill list management, using mutations to add/update roles in the backend.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleMatchResu: Displays a list of job role match results sorted by compatibility percentage, showing match scores, skill counts, progress bars, and a button to view detailed analysis for each role.
Radio group component that fetches and displays available job roles with their required skills, allowing users to select one role for analysis.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header navigation, showing different menu items based on authentication and admin status, including mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that handles Internet Identity login/logout, clearing the query cache on logout and managing loading states.
frontend/src/components/ProficiencyGapCh: Displays a bar chart showing the distribution of matching and missing skills across beginner, intermediate, and advanced proficiency levels using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for initial user profile setup, collecting name (required), email, education, and experience fields, with form validation and submission to save the user profile.
frontend/src/components/RecommendationsD: Displays personalized learning recommendations for missing skills, including recommended courses with external links and practice projects with descriptions.
frontend/src/components/ResumeList.tsx: Lists all uploaded resumes with metadata (skills, experience, education counts), supports selection and deletion with confirmation dialog, and handles loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/ResumeUpload.tsx: Handles PDF resume upload with validation, parses resume content using NLP service, extracts skills, validates required sections (experience, skills, education), and converts data to backend format before uploading.
frontend/src/components/ScoreBreakdown.t: Displays detailed resume scoring breakdown with overall score visualization, category scores (completeness, content quality) with progress bars, and color-coded feedback items.
frontend/src/components/SkillCategoryCha: Bar chart component showing matching and missing skills grouped by category (technical vs. soft skills) using Recharts.
Pie chart visualization showing the proportion of matching skills versus missing skills using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/SkillMatchGapDis: React component that displays a detailed skill gap analysis comparing user skills against job role requirements, categorizing skills as matching, missing, or insufficient proficiency with visual badges and icons.
React component that renders categorized skill badges (technical, soft, domain) with proficiency-level color coding and visual indicators.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication, automatically recreating it when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, job roles, and resumes, providing CRUD operations with optimistic updates and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useResumeAnalysis.ts: Custom mutation hook that orchestrates resume analysis by parsing files with AI, saving extracted data to backend, and uploading file blobs with progress tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, education-focused color palette for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AddJobRolePage.tsx: Admin-only page component for creating new job roles, featuring a form wrapped in an AdminGuard with navigation and success/cancel handlers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page for managing job roles with CRUD operations, displaying job roles in cards with skill requirements, proficiency levels, and delete confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that displays comprehensive skill analysis results including match percentages, skill gaps, recommendations, and various charts after validating resume data from navigation state.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisFlow.tsx: Main analysis workflow page that handles resume upload/selection, job role matching, and orchestrates skill extraction and gap analysis for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/ComprehensiveResultPa: Detailed results page for a specific resume showing score breakdown, skill categorization, gap analysis, recommendations, with editing capabilities and resume comparison features.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and feature cards explaining the four-step process: upload resume, select job role, get analysis, and receive recommendations.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeResultsPage.tsx: Displays comprehensive resume analysis results including resume score, contact information, work experience, education, skills (categorized as technical/soft/domain), and certifications. Uses AdminGuard for access control and fetches data via useGetResumeData hook.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeUploadPage.tsx: Provides a drag-and-drop interface for uploading resume files (PDF, JPG, PNG up to 10MB) with progress tracking. Uses useResumeAnalysis hook to process uploads and navigates to results page upon successful analysis.
frontend/src/services/aiResumeParser.ts: Exports parseResumeWithAI function that converts uploaded files to bytes and calls extractComprehensiveResumeData from nlpService to extract structured resume data including contact info, skills, experience, education, and certifications.
frontend/src/services/gapAnalysis.ts: Performs skill gap analysis by comparing resume skills against job role requirements, identifying missing skills, matching skills, and skills with insufficient proficiency levels. Returns analysis results with resume context including experience, education, and certifications.
frontend/src/services/nlpService.ts: Provides text extraction from PDF bytes and parsing functions to extract structured resume data including contact information, professional summary, work experience, education, skills, certifications, and languages from raw resume text.
frontend/src/services/pdfGenerator.ts: Generates downloadable text-based skill gap analysis reports containing job role match percentage, matching/missing skills, personalized recommendations with courses and projects, and candidate profile details from resume context.
frontend/src/services/recommendationEngi: Generates personalized course and project recommendations based on skill gaps, using hardcoded databases of courses (Udemy, Coursera, etc.) and project ideas mapped to specific skills like JavaScript, Python, React, SQL, and more.
frontend/src/services/resumeScoring.ts: Calculates a comprehensive resume score (out of 100) across four dimensions: completeness, content quality, formatting, and skill relevance, providing detailed feedback for each criterion.
frontend/src/services/skillExtraction.ts: Extracts and categorizes skills from parsed resume data into technical, soft, and domain categories, and calculates experience level and total years of experience from work history.
frontend/src/services/skillMatching.ts: Implements skill matching algorithms that compare resume skills against job role requirements, considering both skill names and proficiency levels to calculate match percentages and identify gaps.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended typography, container queries, animations, and custom design tokens for a consistent UI theme.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file containing existing features for admin job role management (creation page, navigation, routing) and pending feature requests for rebuild/redeploy and adding job roles page. Uses schema version 1.0.0 at project state version 5.
